title: Punch Off
description:
Two [gold]Punch Constructs[/gold] are duking it out and you see some treasure in between them...

Should you try to nab it?

options.title: Nab
options.description: Add [red]Injury[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].

notes: This is a multi-stage event. If you choose [gold]Nab[/gold], you receive an [red]Injury[/red] curse and a random [gold]Relic[/gold]. You then get hit for damage and the event ends. If you choose [gold]I Can Take Them[/gold], the Punch Constructs stop their animation loop and you enter combat against them. Defeating them grants 1 [gold]Relic[/gold] and 1 [gold]Potion[/gold]. During the initial event display, two Punch Constructs perform continuous attack animations at each other.
